headline: Denso Navigates Ransomware Disruption with Minimal Production Impact
body: In a recent cybersecurity incident, Denso Corp, a key auto parts supplier, faced a ransomware attack targeting their office and scheduling IT infrastructure. Despite this, essential machining operations remained largely unaffected, thanks to manual workarounds implemented by the company. Although some shipments might see slight delays, Denso reassures that these will be minor. Precautionary notifications have been sent to customer plants to maintain transparency.
